name: wbam
label: AM broadcast
description: Wideband AM receiver authored as one cross-env doc. Structurally a mirror of wbfm.json — same node-side Soapy source and Channelizer, same cross-env boundary at chan→decim (env_split inserts the WsBridgeTx/WsBridgeRx pair on load). The browser half decimates to 48 kHz, runs an envelope-detector AM demod with a 100 ms DC-blocker time constant, and feeds the AudioSink ring. The source block params match wbfm.json so a receivers-pane toggle can swap just the demod chain and the runtime's diff plan stays local to the browser half.
